name: Dobrila
role: old weaver of Hadrun; Radanya's friend
backstory: One of Hadrun's few living survivors of 1423, Dobrila keeps a box of Berov and Radanya's things, a tusk-comb, a clay cup and a letter she can't read, and will call Chadickith by his childhood pet-name in front of anyone.
dm_only: The letter mentions the great bird circling the Spire 'fat and wrong' in spring 1423.

relationships.name: Chadickith
relationships.how: his mother's friend; keeps his parents' things
